page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family virtual machine configured with 96 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The underlying hardware features an Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor with 48 physical cores, 2 threads per core, and a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. It includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

This server is equipped with 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput, all placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth tests also show top-tier results for large block reads and writes, reaching 506.7 GB/sec and 207.77 GB/sec respectively, which supports memory-intensive workloads.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local storage, the E96ds_v6 offers high resource density for memory-bound applications. It is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, data analytics, and software compilation. The inclusion of AMX instructions also enables efficient CPU-based LLM inference, as reflected in its strong performance in prompt processing benchmarks.
